name: people-front-final
prompt:
Edit this sprite atlas for production use. Preserve all 12 original identities, facial features, normal body proportions, hand-painted thin-line art, clothes and original FOUR-column SIX-row identity order. Produce exactly 24 full-body sprites on GENUINELY TRANSPARENT alpha, with no colored haze or opaque backdrop. Fit each character strictly inside its equal square cell: head at 12% and feet at 86% of cell height, centered, no body part crossing into any adjacent cell, at least 10% clear margin at top/bottom. Each adjacent pair keeps the two opposite walking phases.
Make only these additional prop corrections: the chef pair in row5 col1/2 walk with empty relaxed hands (remove ladle); the waitress pair row5 col3/4 walk empty-handed (remove trays and food); the cleaner pair row6 col1/2 walk empty-handed (remove mop). Keep everyone else's outfit and handbag/briefcase/art bag. Do not add backgrounds, gridlines, labels or new characters. Maintain exactly 4 columns and 6 rows, portrait 2:3 atlas.

name: people-back
prompt:
Create the matching BACK-VIEW walking sprite atlas for the provided front-view atlas. The input is the identity/costume/art-style reference. EXACT SAME 12 original characters, identical clothes/colors/hairstyles/body proportions, thin brown ink and soft painted shading. Strict FOUR columns SIX rows, 24 equal square cells, portrait 2:3. Row-major identity order MUST match input: row1 striped-shirt young man pair then cream/coral young woman pair; row2 boy pair then braided girl pair; row3 elderly man pair then elderly woman pair; row4 office man pair then office woman pair; row5 chef pair then waitress pair; row6 cleaner woman pair then artist man pair.
Show ALL figures in elevated map-camera THREE-QUARTER BACK view walking AWAY toward upper-right, so backs and backs of heads are visible, not faces. For each adjacent pair use opposite leg forward walk phases. Chef, waitress and cleaner have EMPTY hands, no ladle/tray/mop. Other bags remain. Each full body strictly within its square cell, head at12%, feet at86%, x50%, transparent margins. True transparent background, no scenery, gridlines, text, labels, frames, floor shadows, haze or watermark. Not chibi, not flat vector. Preserve 6.5-head adult proportions.

name: people-actions
prompt:
Create a production ACTION sprite atlas matching the people in input EXACTLY in identity, face, clothes, palette, normal human proportions and thin-line softly hand-painted Chinese nostalgic comic game style. Camera elevated 32-degree orthographic map view. EXACTLY FOUR columns and SIX rows, 24 equal square cells, portrait 2:3, on true transparent alpha. Each complete figure strictly inside its cell, 10% clear margins; no gridlines, labels, scenery or UI.
Rows1-4 use the same eight guest identities and same order as source. Each adjacent pair is one person SITTING on an INVISIBLE chair (do not draw chair/table) at natural dining seat height, torso three-quarter toward screen-right. First cell of pair: sitting relaxed with hands in lap. Second: eating with a white ceramic bowl and chopsticks. All legs and shoes complete, knees bent, no squat, no chair drawn. Row1 striped young man pair, cream/coral young woman pair; row2 boy pair, braided girl pair; row3 elderly man pair, plum-blouse elderly woman pair; row4 office man pair, office woman pair.
Row5 special employees: cell1 same chef standing chopping with a knife, hands extended at waist height, NO counter drawn; cell2 same chef stirring with a ladle; cell3 same waitress holding a small notepad greeting a diner; cell4 same waitress carrying a food tray at waist height.
Row6: cell1 same cleaner woman leaning forward wiping with a small cloth; cell2 same cleaner woman washing a ceramic bowl; cell3 same artist man seated relaxed; cell4 same artist man seated eating with bowl and chopsticks.
Only people and their small actual hand tools or bowls. No furniture, floor, background, grid, text, haze, borders or shadows outside sprite. Actual transparent alpha. Maintain rich faces, fabric folds and subtle realistic shading, never geometric/chibi/vector art.
